cc:Work.dc:title: Analytic coordinate shear
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact polynomial shear F(x,y)=(x,y+x²). Grid lines and tangent vectors are specified in AN01-U076, equations 15–16. CC0; GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI), Ultra.
